title: Missing product returns 200 with an empty body instead of 404

issue.title: GET /products/{id} returns 200 for products that do not exist
issue.body: Requesting a product id that is not in the catalogue returns HTTP 200 with every field set to null, instead of HTTP 404. Clients cannot distinguish a missing product from a valid one.
issue.repro_steps: GET /products/999 returns 200 with all fields null.
issue.expected_behavior: Unknown product ids return 404. Existing products are unaffected.

expected_root_cause: The get_product route returns an empty ProductOut when the repository returns None instead of raising HTTPException(404).
